blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Welcome to London. London is the home of Czarnikow since 1861. It is a big city, and it is the capital of England.

In this first lesson you meet the words you hear at the airport. You also meet the little verb to be: am, is, are. This verb is in every English sentence.

Take your time. English comes in CAN's, not in CAN'Ts. Confidence is built one word at a time. I am here to learn, step by step.

items.q: What is London to Czarnikow?
items.why: "London is the home of Czarnikow since 1861."

items.q: London is the capital of…
items.why: "it is the capital of England."

items.q: Which little verb does the lesson teach?
items.why: "the little verb to be: am, is, are."

items.q: "English comes in CAN's, not in CAN'Ts." The author most likely wants you to feel…
items.why: Inferência: a frase é uma mensagem de confiança — foco no que você pode fazer.

items.q: "Confidence is built one word at a time" suggests that learning English is…
options: fast and easy in one day
items.why: Inferência: "one word at a time" e "step by step" indicam um processo gradual.

blocks.instruction: Ouça a colega da Czarnikow recebendo você em Londres. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hello, and welcome to London! I am so happy you are here. My name is Emma, and I am your colleague at Czarnikow.

This is your first visit, so let me help you. London is a big city. It is the capital of England. Our office is in the City, near a famous bridge. The bridge is over the river Thames.

Do not worry about transport. Taxis and buses are easy to find. The Underground is very practical, too. It is fast, and it is not expensive.

You are part of a global team now. Your colleagues in London are friendly, and we are all here to help you. Big Ben is close to the office. It is a famous landmark, and it is beautiful at night.

Take your time. You are ready for this new challenge. One word at a time — that is all. See you tomorrow!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Who is speaking?
items.why: "My name is Emma, and I am your colleague at Czarnikow."

items.q: Where is the Czarnikow office?
options: In the City, near a famous bridge
items.why: "Our office is in the City, near a famous bridge."

items.q: What does Emma say about the Underground?
options: It is fast and not expensive
It is far from the office
items.why: "The Underground is very practical… It is fast, and it is not expensive."

items.q: How does Emma most likely want the new employee to feel?
items.why: Inferência: o tom é caloroso — "welcome", "do not worry", "take your time".

items.q: "You are part of a global team now" suggests that the employee…
options: is only a visitor for one day
now belongs to a bigger, worldwide company
items.why: Inferência: "global team" indica pertencer a uma empresa mundial, não trabalhar sozinho.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "London is a very big city." A city is…
options: a big town where many people live
items.why: City = cidade, um lugar grande onde muitas pessoas vivem.

items.q: "London is the capital of England." A capital is…
options: the main city of a country
items.why: Capital = a cidade principal de um país.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The Thames is a long ___ in London."
items.why: River = rio. O Tâmisa é um rio.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "We walk over the ___ to cross the river."
items.why: Bridge = ponte, usada para atravessar o rio.

items.q: "Welcome to London!" London is…
items.why: London = Londres, a capital da Inglaterra e casa da Czarnikow.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que você ouve no trabalho e ao chegar a uma cidade nova. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Welcome to London!" We say welcome to when…
options: we greet someone who arrives at a place
items.why: Welcome to… = Bem-vindo a…, quando alguém chega a um lugar.

items.q: "Take your time." This means…
items.why: Take your time = com calma, sem pressa.

items.q: "Taxis and buses are easy to find in London." This means they are…
items.why: Easy to find = fáceis de encontrar.

items.q: "I am here to learn, step by step." Step by step means…
options: slowly, one part at a time
items.why: Step by step = passo a passo, uma parte de cada vez.

items.q: "You are part of a global team now." To be part of a team means to…
items.why: Part of = fazer parte de, pertencer ao grupo.
